purpose: Transparent exploratory all-subsets control search for equity-fund H1; all attempted models retained, no multiple-testing adjustment by explicit user instruction.
control_masks: All integers 0..65535, bit j includes controls[j]; same ordered rows for every model.
selection_and_data: Existing P99 continuing-positive upper trim, confirmed entries +100%, exits -100%, existing equity focus and historical eligibility >=60 rows AND >=24 intervals fixed before lag-completeness. No new row filters, cuts, transformations, weighting or support thresholds.
inference: Native-equivalent two-sided t with df_resid; joint current/lag chi2(2), sum uses two-sided t; undefined covariance retained, no correction on p-values.
native_refits: Every deduplicated shortlist model is refit in PanelOLS with unchanged fund FE and fund/company CGM; full native TXT/HTML and all coefficients saved.
benchmark: 1024 fits per variant before full grid; if projected total exceeds 10 min, stop for root decision.
limitations: Post-hoc specification search; ordinary p-values do not establish confirmatory hypothesis support after search.
Contemporaneous controls; estimated quantities not comprehensive corporate-action-adjusted transactions.
All models share complete-case lag sample, not broader original no-lag sample.
